query: What major internal committees or groups will support AI governance?
response:
Part 1:  
Major internal groups supporting AI governance will include the Artificial Intelligence R&D Interagency Working Group (AI R&D IWG), the NSTC Select Committee on AI, the Subcommittee on Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the NITRD Subcommittee, and related AI oversight and advisory groups under the National Artificial Intelligence Initiative Office.

Part 2:  
The AI R&D IWG coordinates federal AI research and development across dozens of agencies and operates through the NITRD Subcommittee to advance the mission of the National AI Initiative Office. It is directly tasked by the NSTC Select Committee on AI and the Subcommittee on Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, making these committees central players in governance and coordination. In parallel, AI oversight and advisory groups identified in federal requirements, laws, executive orders, and guidance help define roles and responsibilities and ensure agencies follow consistent AI practices. Together, these interagency bodies form the core internal architecture for federal AI governance and policy implementation.
